source.dataset: doi:10.5258/SOTON/D1747 (University of Southampton ePrints 449632, files MoSe2_Data.xlsx / WSe2_Data.xlsx, sheet 'Processed A1s Data')
source.paper: McDonnell, Viner, Rivera, Xu, Smith 2020, 2D Materials 'Observation of intravalley phonon scattering of 2s excitons in MoSe2 and WSe2 monolayers' (arXiv:2006.05912; journal volume/DOI not verified here)
source.figure: Main text of the companion paper arXiv:2006.05912 (249.3 cm-1 peak assigned to single-phonon A1'/E' scattering in hBN-encapsulated monolayer WSe2); Fig. 1 colour plots

notes: Processed spectrum as deposited (parallel minus crossed polarisation subtraction to remove PL, thin-film-interference corrected, absolute scattering probability x1e8; NOT raw counts). hBN-encapsulated monolayer, 4 K, resonance Raman near the A1s exciton at 1.7762 eV (698.0 nm). Excitation-dependent relative intensities: other weaker peaks exist but only the single-phonon peak whose position the paper states is listed. Si 520 cm-1 substrate peak may appear. UNVERIFIED transfer: peak position 249.3 cm-1 comes from the companion paper (dataset DOI 10.5258/SOTON/D1315, whose xlsx files are empty on the server), not from the paper that describes this 449632 dataset; the 449632 spectrum peaks at ~250 cm-1.
